summary: Advanced the remaining service-gate implementation again and tightened the last local CI/browser failure paths. This iteration restored deterministic CI compatibility for the shared browse regression by reintroducing Playwright request mocks in `tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts`, switching the assertions to stable route-owned panels instead of translated filter labels or page-global first-element selectors, and keeping the regression within the bootstrap validator’s route-mock contract. I also brought `.gitlab-ci.yml` back into the validator’s pinned TEST-G3 shape by restoring the expected service E2E glob commands and making `deploy-development` wait on `service-quote-gates` and `service-quote-e2e`, so failing service gates can no longer race ahead of deploy. On the Mobile Safari hardening side, the public `/tasks` and `/services` layouts now fail open when Capacitor `Preferences.get(...)` throws, `BottomNavBar.svelte` no longer treats token-storage failures as fatal during initial auth-state detection, and `/tasks` no longer ships the dev-only performance testing helper or double-awaits route translations before the browse shell can paint. The current patch set is diff-clean on the touched files. Local verification is still open because the clean post-patch `npm run build` / validator / browser reruns have not yet completed on this final state, so the last TEST-G3 / TEST-G4 evidence is not ready to mark complete yet.
remaining_work: Finish a clean `npm run build` on the final patch set, then rerun `npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap` to confirm the restored CI/bootstrap contract is green.
Rerun `tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts` on Chromium and Mobile Safari against the final patched build to confirm the Mobile Safari browse regression is resolved.
If the targeted browse rerun is green, rerun the full Mobile Safari non-visual aggregate and the final Chromium visual bundle to close the remaining local `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence.

If Mobile Safari still fails after the current fail-open/bootstrap cleanup, continue the route-specific hardening pass on the remaining `/tasks` / `/services` startup delta until the cross-browser aggregate is clean.

Verify the remaining external `CI-G1` GitLab merge-policy requirements (`only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, required jobs active for merge requests) using `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `CI_API_V4_URL`, and `CI_PROJECT_ID` or the real GitLab CI environment.
